```{r setup, include=FALSE}
list.files(all.files = TRUE)
renv::initi() 
renv::status() #see all packages in lockfile
renv::activate() #activating renv
renv::snapshot() #take a snapshot of your renv
renv::restore() #restore renv 
install.packages("tidyverse") #instal packages to new project
install.packages("renv")
library(renv)
library(tidyverse)
library(dplyr)
install.packages("ggpubr")
library(ggpubr)
renv::install("tibble")
library(tibble)
```

```{r inspect iris}
data(iris)
head(iris)           
str(iris)            #Species is a factor
summary(iris)       
dim(iris)            
names(iris)          

df <- as_tibble(iris) #convert to tibble df
df
```

```{r visualization w ggplot2}
#Scatter plot
p_scatter <- ggplot(data = df, aes(x = Sepal.Length, y = Sepal.Width)) +
  geom_point(aes(color = Species, shape = Species)) +
  xlab("Sepal Length") +
  ylab("Sepal Width") +
  ggtitle("Sepal Length-Width")
p_scatter
ggsave("../figures/scatter_sepal.png",p_scatter,
  width = 6,
  height = 4,
  dpi = 300)

#Box plot 
p_box <- ggplot(data = df, aes(x = Species, y = Sepal.Length)) +
  geom_boxplot(aes(fill = Species)) +
  ylab("Sepal Length") +
  ggtitle("Iris Boxplot") +
  stat_summary(fun = mean, geom = "point", shape = 5, size = 4)
p_box
ggsave("../figures/boxplot_sepal_length.png", p_box, width = 6, height = 4, dpi = 300)

#Histogram
p_hist <- ggplot(data = df, aes(x = Sepal.Width)) +
  geom_histogram(binwidth = 0.2, color = "black", aes(fill = Species)) +
  xlab("Sepal Width") +
  ylab("Frequency") +
  ggtitle("Histogram of Sepal Width")
p_hist
ggsave("../figures/histogram_sepal_width.png", p_hist, width = 6, height = 4, dpi = 300)

#Bar plot
p_bar <- ggplot(data = df, aes(x = Species)) +
  geom_bar(aes(fill = Species)) +
  xlab("Species") +
  ylab("Count") +
  ggtitle("Number of flowers per species")
p_bar
ggsave("../figures/barplot_species.png", p_bar, width = 6, height = 4, dpi = 300)

#Facet one panel per species
p_facet <- ggplot(data = df, aes(x = Sepal.Length, y = Sepal.Width, color = Species)) +
  geom_point(aes(shape = Species), size = 1.5) +
  xlab("Sepal Length") +
  ylab("Sepal Width") +
  ggtitle("Faceting") +
  facet_grid(. ~ Species)
p_facet
ggsave("../figures/facet_sepal.png", p_facet, width = 8, height = 4, dpi = 300)
```

```{r customize plots}
#Change color, font
p_width_lenght <- ggplot(df, aes(x = Petal.Length, y = Petal.Width, color = Species)) +
  geom_point(size = 2.5, alpha = 0.7) +
  labs(
    title    = "Petal dimensions of three different iris species",
    subtitle = "Iris dataset, n = 150",
    x        = "Petal length (cm)",
    y        = "Petal width (cm)",
    color    = "Species",
    caption  = "Data: built-in iris dataset"
  ) +
  scale_color_brewer(palette = "Set1") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    plot.title      = element_text(face = "bold"),
    legend.position = "bottom"
  )
p_width_lenght
ggsave("../figures/custom_petal.png", p_custom, width = 6, height = 4.5, dpi = 300)

#Use ggpubr
p_pub <- ggboxplot(
  df, x = "Species", y = "Petal.Length",
  color = "Species", palette = "jco", add = "jitter"
) +
  stat_compare_means(
    comparisons = list(
      c("setosa", "versicolor"),
      c("versicolor", "virginica"),
      c("setosa", "virginica")
    ),
    method = "wilcox.test"
  )
p_pub
ggsave("../figures/ggpubr_boxplot_petal_length.png", p_pub, width = 6, height = 5, dpi = 300)

#Regression line and correlation coefficient
p_cor <- ggscatter(
  df, x = "Sepal.Length", y = "Petal.Length",
  add = "reg.line", conf.int = TRUE,
  cor.coef = TRUE, cor.method = "pearson"
)
p_cor
ggsave("../figures/ggpubr_scatter_cor.png", p_cor, width = 6, height = 4.5, dpi = 300)
```
